ideas.pitch: AI-powered satellite imagery monitoring platform to track stubble burning and crop health across Haryana agricultural districts.
ideas.title: HaryanaAgro-SatelliteMonitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the GeoNex-ATLAS pattern by building a concrete regional monitoring tool addressing a major environmental and administrative problem highly relevant to state-level judges in Haryana.

ideas.pitch: Graph-based alternative credit scoring and risk assessment platform for micro, small, and medium enterprises in Haryana industrial hubs.
ideas.title: HaryanaMSME-CreditGraph
ideas.why_it_could_win: Employs graph intelligence similar to the Bito winning project, offering a sophisticated technical implementation that stands out to technical judges.

ideas.pitch: Multi-agent AI support platform for campus sustainability initiatives and green audit tracking designed for universities in Haryana.
ideas.title: CampusGreen-Haryana
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adopts the multi-agent RAG architecture from the greennovation-ai-platform win, ensuring strong practical utility for educational institutions.

ideas.pitch: GPS-enabled civic reporting app that rewards citizens in Haryana for reporting potholes, street light failures, and municipal issues with a live council dashboard.
ideas.title: HaryanaCivic-WalkEarn
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the catwalk win pattern by providing a fully working mobile-responsive UI with a live operational dashboard that immediately demonstrates real-world impact.

ideas.pitch: IoT-connected water quality and drainage level prediction platform for urban flood management in Haryana cities.
ideas.title: AquaSense-HaryanaDrain
ideas.why_it_could_win: Matches the iForeSea win by combining predictive machine learning with local infrastructure monitoring to solve a pressing regional climate problem.
